sample_unit: LLM responses (13 models x 30 hematology key feature questions)

links.outcome: LLM accuracy on novel postgraduate hematology key feature questions requiring free-text clinical decisions
links.effect: Exact accuracy ranged 73.3% to 96.7% across 13 LLMs; 71 of 390 responses incorrect; differences between models not statistically significant (Cochran's Q p = 0.067).
links.quote: Across 390 responses, exact accuracy ranged from 73.3% to 96.7%.

screen.reason: Evaluates the benchmark accuracy and error types of 13 large language models on 30 novel hematology key feature examination questions without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
